source_title: Treatment of Peripheral Facial Paralysis After COVID-19 Infection With TCM Therapies: A Case Report
paraphrase_note: Symptoms/tongue/pulse paraphrased by the harness author from the open-access full text; source pattern and principle are the authors' own.
chief_complaint: Right-sided facial numbness, asymmetry and ear pain for five days after COVID-19 (House-Brackmann grade IV facial palsy).
symptoms: ear pain on the right side
source_pattern: Wind-Cold (with phlegm) obstructing the channels at the acute stage
source_treatment_principle: Expel wind and disperse cold, resolve phlegm and unblock the channels/collaterals (acupuncture, herbs; syndrome changes by stage)

data.wen_inquiry: Chief complaint: Right-sided facial numbness, asymmetry and ear pain for five days after COVID-19 (House-Brackmann grade IV facial palsy). Symptoms: numbness of the right face; facial droop; ear pain on the right side.
